We also offer digitized entertainment services and essential digital marketing strategies like SEO, SMM and Google Ads to enhance brand visibility and drive conversions, completing our MOS Utility Limited June 06, 2024 suite of comprehensive offerings.

Guidance & outlook: As per the Provisional Estimates released by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, real GDP grew 7.7% in FY 2025-26 against 7.1% in FY 2024-25, reaching Rs 323.12 lakh crore at constant prices.
For FY 2026-27, the Reserve Bank has projected real GDP growth of 6.6%, moderating from the FY 2025-26 outturn on account of geopolitical risk and monsoon-related uncertainty.
Unified Payments Interface processed 24,161.69 crore transactions worth Rs 314.23 lakh crore during FY 2025-26, against 18,586.60 crore transactions worth Rs 260.56 lakh crore in FY 2024-25.
Growth & demand: On a standalone basis revenue rose 15.9% to ₹241.07 Cr, while profit after tax grew 32.9% to ₹14.87 Cr and EBITDA improved 26.7% to ₹27.67 Cr, reflecting a shift towards better-margin services and tighter cost discipline.
On a consolidated basis revenue was ₹ 635.24 Cr against ₹ 616.46 Cr, with profit after tax up 37.5% to ₹18.53 Cr and EBITDA up 32.0% to ₹33.15 Cr.
Samvriddhi Inclusive Growth network Private Limited: We have 92.48% Stake in Samvriddhi Inclusive Growth network Private Limited.
Margins & costs: In its April 2026 World Economic Outlook, the International Monetary Fund projected global growth to slow to 3.1% in 2026 and 3.2% in 2027, with global headline inflation rising to about 4.4% in 2026 before resuming its decline.

Profit after tax rose to Rs 1,486.69 lakhs from Rs 1,118.82 lakhs, an increase of about 33%, and earnings per share Margins improved through the year as the mix shifted towards higher-yield services and cost discipline was maintained; the operating profit margin in the fourth quarter was the strongest of the year.
Price wars and margin pressure: aggressive pricing by competitors may exert downward pressure on commissions and margins, potentially requiring pricing adjustments that affect profitability.
